summary: Appends node a1 to the global registry doubly-linked list whose head is dword_8B8E20 (008B8E20). Prev/next node links live at node+0x86C and node+0x870. When the list is empty the new node becomes the head with both links cleared; otherwise it walks the next-pointer chain to the tail, links the tail's next (+0x870) to the new node and sets the new node's prev (+0x86C) to the old tail. Returns the new tail (or the new head when the list was empty). Called by sub_53CFE0 (0053CFE0) and SceneFileTopLevelParser (0055B200).

local_names.result: list tail before link-up; the appended node itself when the list was empty

Walks the next-pointer chain (node+0x870) starting from the head dword_8B8E20 until it reaches the tail whose next is zero
Links the old tail's next pointer (+0x870) to the new node a1

Empty-list path: stores the new node as the head global dword_8B8E20 and clears both of its links (+0x86C and +0x870)
Returns the appended tail node, or the new head when the list was previously empty
